name: twin-reservoir-lab-desktop
description: TWIN Reservoir Lab을 데스크톱 프로그램으로 묶는 Electron 패키지

scripts.pack:mac: npm run stage && electron-packager stage "TWIN Reservoir Lab" --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --icon=icon.icns --out=out --overwrite --app-bundle-id=kr.twin.reservoirlab --app-version=1.6.1 --app-copyright="TWIN research prototype"
scripts.pack:mac-intel: npm run stage && electron-packager stage "TWIN Reservoir Lab" --platform=darwin --arch=x64 --icon=icon.icns --out=out --overwrite --app-bundle-id=kr.twin.reservoirlab --app-version=1.6.1
scripts.pack:win: npm run stage && electron-packager stage "TWIN Reservoir Lab" --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=out --overwrite --app-version=1.6.1 && node win-resources.mjs
scripts.dist:mac: npm run stage && electron-builder --config builder.yml --mac dmg --arm64
